title: Update
body: just a question: How to update ShadowDumper with a Working copy of Mimikatz for Windows 11
author: stilllearning65

comments.body: This is something you need to modify the mimikatz. First set argument's when the mimikatz execute, it should run all command on execution. After that convert modified mimikatz into PIC and use as a resource in shadowdumper Injector.

title: Not working Windows 11 23H2
body:
Using Parameter 1 gives the following error output:

Using 'C:\Users\Public\PANDA.txt' for logfile : OK

mimikatz(commandline) # privilege::debug
Privilege '20' OK

mimikatz(commandline) # panda::panda
ERROR kuhl_m_sekurlsa_acquireLSA ; Logon list

mimikatz(commandline) # exit
Bye!
author: stilllearning65

comments.body: Changes in OS architecture and security features (Win 11 23H2) break the older version of mimikatz. We are using the older version here. You can use the latest releases of mimikatz to find the compatible version. Alternatively, you can try other methods to dump the memory and parse it offline.
